descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P0 · stated in the UAT / ticket AC · UAT EFS state 7; TFA-94745 state 7 · “Photo capture found no patients / unreadable photo | Explicit message; nothing added”.

Approach · EFS Empty & Failure States · S11 Photo capture with no patients on it and with an unreadable file, in both contexts: explicit message, nothing added

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U7 Photo capture found no patients, or the photo is unreadable: an explicit message, and nothing is added. (UAT EFS state 7; TFA-94745 state 7)
  • U11 Every state shows a clear, plain-language message in the app's existing style that tells the physician what to do next (retry, enable permission, sign in, check connection). (UAT EFS Expected Result; TFA-94745 AC 1; TFA-94745 AC 5)
  • U12 No state ever shows a blank screen, a crash, a raw error pop-up, or invented content. (UAT EFS intro; UAT 3.4; TFA-94745 AC 2)
  • U14 Every state works in both Hospital and Nursing Home, on web, iOS and Android. (UAT EFS Expected Result; UAT 3.3; TFA-94745 AC 6)

Test design technique: Equivalence classes (equivalence) — Check the same rule again with another class of input (Hospital / Nursing Home, other data); every class has to be right.

Given Standard fixture (one patient, one resident); two synthetic images: a photo of a cafeteria menu (no names) and a corrupt .jpg of random bytes

When Open the Hospital scan control and pick the menu photo; then the corrupt file; close the scan; repeat with the Nursing Home resident-list scan

Then The menu photo ends with a message that no patients / residents were found; the corrupt file ends with a message that the photo couldn't be read; each says what to do (clearer photo, retake, try again); no row is offered for import; the lists still hold only the fixture patient and resident

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): From U7: menu-photo checkpoints mustContain 'no patients found' (Hospital) / 'no residents found' (Nursing Home), corrupt-file checkpoints mustContain 'be read', each with a next-step group, and all mustNotContain the menu items; list checkpoints mustContain the fixture name and mustNotContain the menu items; post-run backend read: exactly 1 Hospital patient and 1 resident. …

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S11 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/EFS.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 8b4be94a (10-20), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-c.

Test method: AGENT · Browser agent — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: newspec-c.

UAT item: EFS Empty & Failure States · Section: A5 · Cross-Cutting · Scenario: EFS/S11

Photo capture with no patients on it and with an unreadable file, in both contexts: explicit message, nothing added

Tickets: TFA-94745 Empty & Failure States (ready for qa)

New local lane newspec-c: status passed in newspec-c/results.json → passed (passed).

Detail:

14/14 judged cells passed; the corrupt-file leg (our addition) is record-only, 9/9 notes as expected (newspec-c/vis-efs-s11-photo-empty-unreadable.spec.ts, desktop Chromium, one fixture patient + one resident). Media made in the run: a cafeteria-menu JPEG (Tomato soup, Grilled cheese, ...) and 2 KB of random bytes named efs-corrupt.jpg. No model: ai/vision:scanCensusSheet was answered in the browser the way the server ends for each photo - the menu as a successful read with zero rows, the random bytes as a failed read (a provider rejects non-image bytes). Hospital menu: 'No patients found in the image. Try a clearer photo.', Nursing Home menu: 'No residents found. Try a clearer photo.'; no row or Add button offered, no menu text on screen. Corrupt file, both contexts: 'The photo couldn't be read. Check your connection and try again, or retake the photo.'; no raw provider error or 'undefined' on screen, no row offered. After closing each sheet the lists still hold only the fixture patient / resident, and the server holds exactly 1 patient and 1 resident. Recorded: the client sends any picked file to the server unchecked (the 2 KB random file went out as a 2,732-character base64 image in both contexts); what the real vision provider answers for such bytes is not exercised (no live model); both 'no patients / residents found' messages are plain text, not live regions. B01 (real reads on dev always say 'no patients found') is not touched by this scenario: the photo really has nobody on it.

Evidence: 7 attached; 3 not attached:

  • newspec-c/evidence/efs-s11-media — a folder (2 items), not attached
  • newspec-c/evidence/efs-s11-media/efs-corrupt.jpg — .jpg files are not attached
  • newspec-c/evidence/efs-s11-media/efs-menu.jpg — .jpg files are not attached

Dev run: skipped: not runnable on dev — not-runnable-on-dev: synthetic-media, oracle-controls. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
